name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: SYNTH-SIGN-ENCRYPT BUILD, not for production: fixes the real cause of 0.4.15/16's NS_ERROR_ILLEGAL_VALUE -- MimeCryptoHackCerts() resolves each recipient's cert purely from an in-memory cache (empty for our freshly created composeSecure), landing an empty dbKey in findCertByDBKey(''). Pre-populates that cache via cacheValidCertForEmail() before calling beginCryptoEncapsulation(), same as a real compose window does as the user types a recipient.
